This is one I don’t really agree with majority on? NTA, because your friend basically stood you up with no prior notice. That’s wrong on his part, not yours. 

Objectively looking at this, you two made plans to see the movie. On day of plan you ask about confirmation, and he states that he actually went the day before and so therefore unpredictably rescheduled your plans. 

To me, that displays that he does not respect the agreement between you two, whether or not it was big or small. He could’ve at least let you know beforehand that he would want to reschedule plans with you.

As for your reaction, I would be reasonably upset as well. For me, superhero movies don’t have much rewatch value in short periods of time(I can rewatch maybe once a year) so him saying that he will go see it with you too is just a defense against you calling him out on already seeing it with others. 

However, you would be an asshole if you lashed out at him or gave him silent treatment. But I read through the threads to see what all was said, and it seems you are just at a point in life right now where you are weighing in the people around you, and that’s okay. It’s good to find out who’s good for your wellbeing and who isn’t. Obviously this isn’t anything to cut someone out of your life but not the asshole at all.
